caption:
Forgot your WordPress password? Try this order: 🔑
1. Click "Lost your password?" on the login page
2. Check spam for the reset email
3. Still nothing? Ask your host to help reset it

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

scenes.text: Locked out of your WordPress dashboard?
scenes.say: Locked out of your WordPress dashboard? Don't panic. Try this.

scenes.title: Get back in
scenes.say: On the login page, click Lost your password. Enter your username or email. Then open the reset email and choose a new password.

scenes.myth: The reset email never came, so it's lost.
scenes.fact: Check your spam folder first. Emails from sites often land there.
scenes.say: No email? Check your spam folder first. Emails from websites often land there.

scenes.title: Ask your hosting support
scenes.body: They can reset the password for you.
scenes.say: Still stuck? Ask your hosting support. They can help you reset the password.

scenes.title: Save it in a password manager
scenes.body: So you never get locked out again.
scenes.say: Once you are in, save the new password in a password manager so you never get locked out again.
